narration: Darkness, and then a floor of it: you feel cool, pale ground settle beneath your boots, fine as ash and faintly silver. Far to the north, a single small light flickers, amber and patient, as if it has been waiting for someone to look.

facts.description: A wide flat plain of fine pale silver-grey ash-like dust, softly glowing, stretching out in every direction into darkness.
facts.placement: covers the ground under and around the wanderer, extending at least 40 m in all directions

facts.description: A small amber flame-like light, about the size of a lantern, hovering low and flickering gently.
facts.placement: about 40 m north of the wanderer, about 1.5 m above the ground
